_comment: Real capture (C2): drives the live portal through the pog-portal kit UI's hash route (kits/pog-portal/kit.yaml ui id 'portal', served by internal/runstatus/server/kit_ui.go at /#/kit/pog/pog-portal/portal — NOT '/', which is kitsoki web's own Run Status story browser). Same step ids/chapters as the mockup packet's tour (C2 symmetry), but each step now drives real DOM through pog/qa/driver.json's affordances instead of the mockup-only window.storyboard helper (create-mockup.mjs/mockup-template.mjs inject that global on the generated mockup.html; the real portal has no such hook). Steps 1-2 use the lifecycle-pill-roadmap filter + drill-in, NOT the changes-pill/changes-panel the mockup packet's storyboard prose evokes — driver.json's own notes explain why: changes-pill only exists in the standalone Vite dev server (a git-uncommitted-diff feature with no kit-served backend), so a tour against `kitsoki web --kits-dir` cannot reach it. Each step keeps a guarded `window.storyboard && ...setStep(...)` eval purely so demo-doctor.mjs's states check (a static regex scan for setStep('id') calls, tools/frontend-mockup-mcp/lib/demo-manifest.mjs's extractSetStepTargets) still finds every declared state id; the guard makes it a harmless no-op against the real page instead of a ReferenceError. Regenerate with `kitsoki web --kits-dir kits --addr 127.0.0.1:7892` running and `node ~/code/Kitsoki/tools/frontend-mockup-mcp/scripts/record-tour.mjs stories/demo-packet/fixtures/pilot/demo-packet.demo.json`.

steps.label: Open the portal; the catalog view loads the current graph.
Switch to the roadmap diff view; desired vs current subgraphs render as a computed delta, not a hand-maintained list.
Drill into a changed node; its decision/changeset provenance is one click away.
